description: Inherited by every lightspeedwp repository the Mend Renovate app is installed on.
A repository's own renovate.json is applied on top of this file and can override it.

Policy that repository CI gates depend on: labels (meta:no-changelog), branchPrefix (deps/) and prHeader. A repository renovate.json that sets labels replaces this array, so keep meta:no-changelog in it.
prHeader:
## Linked issues

N/A. Automated dependency update opened by Renovate.

## Maintenance summary

Automated update of the dependency or dependencies listed below.

## Impact assessment

Patch, minor, digest and pin updates merge automatically once the required checks pass. Major and 0.x updates stay open for a human to review.

## Test scope

Covered by this repository's CI checks on this pull request.

## Changelog

No changelog entry needed: automated dependency update, labelled `meta:no-changelog`.

packageRules.description: Allow GHCR and Google Artifact Registry image updates without release timestamps; keep the cooldown when a timestamp is available.
Minor and patch updates automerge once checks pass; 0.x releases and majors stay for a human.
Digest, pin and lock-file maintenance updates keep the same version, so they automerge once checks pass.

Keep UI and API images are digest-pinned to one release recorded in keep/versions.env (KEEP_RELEASE) and checked by tests/test-keep-compose-contract.sh. A lone digest bump breaks that pairing, so they are updated by hand at deploy time.
One pull request for all non-major GitHub Actions updates.
